country.match: Match each holiday to the country that celebrates it.
country.odd: Three of these holidays are celebrated in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Ch'usŏk
rows.description: major harvest festival in Korea celebrated on the 15th day of the 8th month of the lunar calendar (the full moon night)
rows.hook: is a harvest festival where families honor ancestors and share half-moon shaped rice cakes

rows.label: Day of the Dead
rows.hook: welcomes back departed loved ones with marigolds, sugar skulls and decorated altars

rows.label: Juneteenth
rows.description: holiday commemorating the emancipation of enslaved African Americans in Texas on June 19, 1865
rows.hook: celebrates the end of slavery with parades, cookouts and readings of an emancipation order

rows.label: Guy Fawkes Night
rows.description: annual commemoration involving bonfires and fireworks displays on 5 November commemorating the Gunpowder Plot in 1605
rows.hook: is marked with bonfires and fireworks recalling a failed plot to blow up parliament

rows.label: Navratri
rows.hook: is a nine-night festival honoring the goddess Durga with dance and fasting

rows.label: Kwanzaa
rows.hook: is a week-long celebration of heritage built on seven principles and a candle holder called a kinara

rows.label: Memorial Day
rows.description: federal holiday in the United States of America for honoring and mourning the U.S. military personnel who died while serving in the United States Armed Forces
rows.hook: honors soldiers who died in service and marks the unofficial start of summer

rows.label: Vijayadashami
rows.description: annual Hindu festival, celebrated at the end of Navaratri
rows.hook: celebrates good triumphing over evil, with effigies of a ten-headed demon king set ablaze

rows.label: Bastille Day
rows.hook: commemorates the storming of a royal prison at the start of a revolution, with a big military parade

rows.label: Gandhi Jayanti
rows.description: national holiday celebrated in India to mark the occasion of the birthday of Mahatma Gandhi
rows.hook: honors the birthday of the leader of a nonviolent independence movement

rows.label: Martin Luther King Jr. Day
rows.hook: honors a civil rights leader famous for the "I Have a Dream" speech

rows.label: Veterans Day
rows.description: federal holiday in the United States
rows.hook: honors all who served in the armed forces, observed on the anniversary of the armistice ending World War I
